questions.question: When God brought the Israelites out of Egypt, what did He say would happen if they obeyed Him?

answers.text: They would be His people and He their God
They would never lose a single battle again
They would rule over every nation on earth

questions.question: God told Jeremiah that disaster would come on Judah and Jerusalem. Who would the people cry out to?

answers.text: The gods they burned incense to

questions.question: God told the prophet Jeremiah to pray for the people of Judah and Jerusalem. True or false?
God told Jeremiah that the covenant He made with Israel's forefathers had been broken. Who broke it?

answers.text: The house of Israel and the house of Judah
